headline: Congress named a post office in Harristown, Illinois, after Logan S. Palmer.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1355 North Meridian Road in Harristown, Illinois, as the "Logan S. Palmer Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal service, hours, mail rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018.
